title: modeldeployment chart values
description: Schema for charts/modeldeployment. Validates the per-InferenceSet inputs whose misconfiguration is surfaced by the modeldeployment-level schema reasons in the end-to-end error-handling proposal (e.g. inferencesetScalingMisconfigured). Cross-field guards that JSON Schema cannot express on its own (notably maxReplicas >= replicas) are additionally enforced by a fail-fast Helm template guard at render time.

stabilizationWindowSeconds.description: HPA stabilization window in seconds, 0..3600 (HPA API limit; numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard). Defaults to 60 (scaleUp) / 1800 (scaleDown); empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default.

periodSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between scaling steps (HPA Pods policy period, one pod per period), 1..1800 (HPA API limit; numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard). Defaults to 900 (scaleUp) / 1800 (scaleDown); empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default.

tolerance.description: HPA scale-up tolerance ratio, 0 <= tolerance < 1. The HPA API only requires >= 0, but at >= 1 the formula's 2.0 scale-up signal never leaves the deadband (numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard). Defaults to 0.1; empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default. 0 disables the deadband. Requires the Kubernetes HPAConfigurableTolerance feature gate.

HPA scale-down tolerance ratio, 0 <= tolerance < 0.5. The HPA API only requires >= 0, but at >= 0.5 the formula's 0.5 scale-down signal never leaves the deadband (numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard). Defaults to 0.1; empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default. 0 disables the deadband. Requires the Kubernetes HPAConfigurableTolerance feature gate.

name.description: Deployment / InferenceSet name. Empty falls back to .Release.Name.

namespace.description: Target workload namespace. Empty falls back to .Release.Namespace.

model.description: Inference preset name set on the InferenceSet. MUST be non-empty.

config.description: Name of a ConfigMap in the deployment namespace containing custom inference arguments. Rendered as spec.template.inference.config.

adapters.description: LoRA adapters loaded by the vLLM runtime. Each source name is also a client-visible model ID and is published to BBR for adapter-to-base-model routing. Adapter names must be cluster-wide unique because BBR's mapping cache is not namespace-scoped. The vLLM-incompatible strength field is intentionally unsupported.

name.description: Unique adapter model ID. Must be a DNS-1123 subdomain and must not equal this deployment's name (the latter is enforced by a Helm template guard).

image.description: Container image containing PEFT adapter files under /data. Mutually exclusive with volumeSource.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secret names used to pull the adapter image.

volumeSource.description: Kubernetes VolumeSource containing the adapter files. Mutually exclusive with image.

modelAccessSecret.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret containing the models access credentials for huggingface. Optional.

instanceType.description: VM instance type used for the underlying GPU nodes.

replicas.description: Number of InferenceSet replicas (spec.replicas). Optional: empty leaves spec.replicas unset (CRD default 1; with enableScaling, KEDA moves it into [minReplicas, maxReplicas]). When set with enableScaling it is applied on install and re-applied only when its value changes, and MUST lie within [minReplicas, maxReplicas] (enforced by a template guard).

minReplicas.description: Autoscaling lower bound wired to scaledobject.kaito.sh/min-replicas. REQUIRED when enableScaling is true (enforced by a template guard); ignored otherwise. 0 enables scale to zero (0 <-> 1, requires keda-kaito-scaler v0.7.0+) and turns on the EPP flowControl feature gate.

enableScaling.description: Toggles KAITO ScaledObject auto-provisioning. When false, minReplicas, maxReplicas and scaling are ignored.

maxReplicas.description: Autoscaling upper bound wired to scaledobject.kaito.sh/max-replicas. REQUIRED when enableScaling is true (enforced by a template guard); ignored otherwise. When enableScaling is true it MUST be at least 1, >= minReplicas and, when set, >= replicas (template guards).

scalingThreshold.description: Deprecated single-metric queue-depth threshold, superseded by scaling.metrics[*].upThreshold/downThreshold. Retained so pre-existing overrides still validate; no longer wired to any annotation.

scaling.description: Composite (multi-metric) autoscaling configuration wired to scaledobject.kaito.sh/* annotations. Consumed only when enableScaling is true; keda-kaito-scaler combines the up/down bands under a conservative AND policy and, when minReplicas is 0, wakes on ANY activation threshold and parks when EVERY deactivation threshold holds. Misconfiguration here is surfaced as inferencesetScalingMisconfigured.

metrics.description: Ordered list of scaling signals. Rendered as the scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics annotation (a YAML list, one entry per metric). MUST contain at least one entry when enableScaling is true (also enforced by a fail-fast template guard). Entries carrying only activationThreshold/deactivationThreshold are skipped when minReplicas >= 1.

name.description: Prometheus metric family name exposed by the metric source (model pods or EPP). Rendered as the `name` field of a scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics entry.

type.description: Aggregation applied to the metric: gauge -> per-replica average (summed across EPP pods for source epp); histogram -> per-pod windowed average (rolling _sum/_count delta over metricCacheWindow). Rendered as the `type` field of a scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics entry. Defaults to gauge.

source.description: Where the metric is scraped: modelpod (the model-serving pods, default) or epp (the Endpoint Picker pods, which keep reporting at zero replicas). Rendered as the `source` field when set.

aggregation.description: Overrides the reduction derived from type and source: sum / service-avg (gauge only) or windowed-avg (histogram only). Rendered as the `aggregation` field when set.

upThreshold.description: Per-replica scale-up threshold (float) for the 1 <-> N range. REQUIRED (together with downThreshold) when minReplicas >= 1, enforced by a fail-fast template guard; optional when minReplicas is 0. MUST be strictly greater than downThreshold. Rendered as the `upthreshold` field of a scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics entry.

downThreshold.description: Per-replica scale-down threshold (float) for the 1 <-> N range. MUST be strictly less than upThreshold and set together with it (enforced by a fail-fast template guard). Rendered as the `downthreshold` field of a scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics entry.

activationThreshold.description: Wake threshold for the 0 -> 1 transition (metric > threshold). Only used when minReplicas is 0; requires source epp and a deactivationThreshold on the same metric. Rendered as the `activationthreshold` field.

deactivationThreshold.description: Park threshold for the 1 -> 0 transition (metric <= threshold, ANDed across metrics). Only used when minReplicas is 0; MUST NOT exceed activationThreshold. At least one modelpod metric must carry one. Rendered as the `deactivationthreshold` field.

metricCacheWindow.description: Rolling cache window in seconds over which keda-kaito-scaler averages a histogram metric's _sum/_count deltas (windowed-avg aggregation); ignored for gauge. Must be a positive number of seconds. Empty inherits keda-kaito-scaler's 300s default. Rendered as the `metriccachewindow` field of a scaledobject.kaito.sh/metrics entry.

hpa.description: HPA behavior of the generated ScaledObject (1 <-> N scaling only). Each field maps to one InferenceSet annotation: scaleUp.stabilizationWindowSeconds -> scaleupstabilizationwindow, scaleUp.periodSeconds -> scaleupcooldown, scaleUp.tolerance -> scaleuptolerance, scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds -> scaledownstabilizationwindow, scaleDown.periodSeconds -> scaledowncooldown, scaleDown.tolerance -> scaledowntolerance (all under scaledobject.kaito.sh/).

initialCooldownPeriod.description: Seconds after ScaledObject creation before KEDA starts applying the scale-to-zero cooldown. Does not delay initial scale-up. Only rendered as scaledobject.kaito.sh/initialcooldownperiod when minReplicas is 0. Defaults to 1800; empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default. KEDA requires >= 0; MUST fit in int32, 0..2147483647 (numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard).

cooldownPeriod.description: Seconds KEDA waits after the last active trigger reading before parking the deployment at zero (0 parks on the first inactive poll). Only rendered (as scaledobject.kaito.sh/cooldownperiod) when minReplicas is 0; ignored otherwise. Defaults to 1800; empty or null lets keda-kaito-scaler apply the same default. KEDA requires >= 0; MUST fit in int32, 0..2147483647 (numeric strings are range-checked by a template guard).

enableBenchmark.description: Toggles KAITO benchmark runs for this InferenceSet. When false, the kaito.sh/disable-benchmark annotation is stamped on the InferenceSet.

performanceMode.description: When non-empty, stamps kaito.sh/performance-mode: <value> on the InferenceSet template so the KAITO controller applies the corresponding vLLM profile. Empty (default) omits the annotation and the controller falls back to its own default (balanced). Allowed values: interactivity (low per-request latency), balanced (trade-off), throughput (maximize aggregate tokens/sec).

streaming.description: KAITO model-streaming annotations stamped onto spec.template.metadata.annotations of the InferenceSet (propagated to child Workspaces).

disabled.description: When 'true', stamps kaito.sh/model-streaming: 'disabled' to force KAITO's download-at-runtime path. Any other value keeps streaming enabled. Mutually exclusive with staticModelMirror. Typed string|boolean because `helm --set` coerces the RP-sent string to a boolean.

staticModelMirror.description: When 'true', the gate that activates the SAS direct-stream path; stamps inference.kaito.sh/static-model-mirror and requires datarefsUrl, identityClientId, and sourceType. Typed string|boolean because `helm --set` coerces the RP-sent string to a boolean.

datarefsUrl.description: SAS-mint endpoint URL, stamped verbatim as inference.kaito.sh/stream-datarefs-url. Consumed only when staticModelMirror is 'true'.

identityClientId.description: UAMI client-id GUID, stamped as inference.kaito.sh/stream-identity-client-id. Must match modelharness serviceAccount.workloadIdentityClientId. Consumed only when staticModelMirror is 'true'.

sourceType.description: Selects KAITO's URL-derivation rule / token audience, stamped as inference.kaito.sh/stream-source-type. The value can only be 'public' or 'byo'. Consumed only when staticModelMirror is 'true'.

gatewayName.description: Gateway the HTTPRoute attaches to. Empty defaults to '<namespace>'.

autoUpgrade.description: KAITO automatic base image upgrade configuration, rendered as spec.autoUpgrade. When enabled, the controller rolls replicas onto a newer embedded base image one at a time after a controller upgrade. Requires the enableBaseImageAutoUpgrade feature gate on the KAITO controller (off by default); this value only opts the InferenceSet in.

enabled.description: Toggles spec.autoUpgrade.enabled. When false (default), the spec.autoUpgrade block is omitted and replicas stay pinned to their creation-time base image.

maintenanceWindow.description: Optionally restricts when rollouts may begin. Consumed only when enabled is true. Omitted entirely when schedule is empty.

schedule.description: 5-field cron expression (UTC) marking the start of each maintenance window, e.g. '0 2 * * 6'. Empty (default) lets upgrades start at any time.

duration.description: How long the window stays open once it opens, e.g. '4h'. Empty inherits the KAITO controller's 4h default. Ignored when schedule is empty.

modelServerPort.description: Port exposed by the inference (model server) pods.

extProcPort.description: EPP gRPC ext_proc port consumed by the Gateway.

flowControl.description: EPP flow-control layer (flowControl feature gate). Turned on automatically when enableScaling is true and minReplicas is 0, so requests are held in the EPP while the deployment is parked.

enabled.description: Forces flow control on even without scale to zero.

maxConcurrency.description: Per-endpoint in-flight request capacity of the concurrency saturation detector. The EPP queues once in-flight requests reach maxConcurrency x endpoints; an empty pool always counts as saturated.

maxBytes.description: Cap on the total size of request bodies buffered in the flow-control queue, as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. "128Mi"). Requests beyond it are rejected with 429. Empty falls back to the EPP's 1GB-per-priority-band limit.

defaultRequestTTL.description: Maximum time a request may wait in the flow-control queue, e.g. "10m". Empty waits until the client cancels.

cloudprovider.description: Cloud provider gate. When empty (default), templates/httproute.yaml renders (header-only routing). When "azure", templates/httproute.yaml is skipped and templates/azure/httproute.yaml renders instead (adds hostnames: [<namespace>.<zoneName>] matching the modelharness Gateway's Azure default-domain HTTPS listener).

azure.description: Azure-specific values consumed by templates/azure/*. Ignored unless cloudprovider="azure".

defaultDomain.description: Drives the `hostnames` field on templates/azure/httproute.yaml so it attaches to the modelharness Gateway's HTTPS default-domain listener.

zoneName.description: Cluster's AKS-issued default-domain zone (without the '*.' prefix). Required when cloudprovider=azure — template renders `fail` otherwise. MUST match the corresponding modelharness release's azure.defaultDomain.zoneName.
